title: Sales Analytics Dashboard
description: A modern, responsive sales analytics dashboard built with React, featuring real-time data visualization, interactive charts, and a sleek dark theme with purple gradients.

title: Lead Management System
description: A full-stack lead capture and management platform with automated follow-ups, built with React, n8n, and Google Sheets.

title: Social media Scheduler
description: An automated workflow built with n8n that schedules and publishes social media content efficiently.

title: Pizzeria Landing Page
description: A modern, responsive landing page for a pizzeria restaurant built with Bootstrap 5. Features stunning animations, glassmorphism design, and an intuitive user experience.

title: Breezo
description: A simple and responsive weather application built with vanilla JavaScript. It fetches real-time weather data from an external API and displays temperature, conditions, and location details in a clean, user-friendly interface.

title: Job Application Follow-Up Automation
description: An automation workflow that captures job applications, stores them in Google Sheets, and sends an automatic follow-up reminder after 7 days.
